slide_title: Self Attention Mechanism (Linear Transformation of Inputs)
subtitle_or_header: (Self Attention of word X₂ w.r.t All words in Sentence ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ )

layout.arrangement: Two-line bold title centered at top on white; yellow slide-number badge '13' at top-right. Below, one large peach panel with thin red border fills the rest of the slide and contains a single left-to-right self-attention flowchart: translucent blue-gray ellipse of input embeddings X₁–X₄ (far left) → bright-green ellipse holding four W_k^(r) boxes → four green K₁–K₄ vectors → gray 'Dot Product' box containing a graph of four blue dots → vertical lavender 'Soft max' block (center) → four red ⊗ multiply nodes stacked under a light-blue Σ box labeled 'Weighted SUM' → green block arrow up to a small dashed output box labeled 'V' (top center-right). A right-hand column of four green W_v^(r) boxes with V₄–V₁ vectors feeds the ⊗ nodes from a green dashed container of X₁–X₄ embeddings at far right. Bottom-left: green dashed container with the sentence embeddings, row X₂ highlighted with red dashed border and a red cursor arrow. Bottom-right: white annotation box with the 1*d → W(d*d) = 1*d dimension note.

layout.hierarchy: The flowchart dominates ~85% of the slide area. Title text is the largest type (bold). Most visually salient: red arrows/labels and bright-green shapes; then the large lavender Softmax block, gray Dot Product box and blue Σ; smallest are the pill labels and vector cell stacks. Blue is reserved for Σ, the pill labels, the title parenthetical and the Dot Product dots; red marks the attended word X₂ and all data-flow arrows.

visual_elements.description: Full-slide content panel: light peach rectangle with thin red border enclosing everything below the title

Input embedding stack: large translucent blue-gray ellipse containing 4 horizontal rows of 3–4 small colored squares (yellow, salmon, purple); each row ends with a red label X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄; short red arrows exit each row rightward into the W_k boxes

Key-matrix stage: bright green vertical ellipse overlapping the input ellipse, holding four stacked green rectangles each labeled 'W_k^(r)' in white (superscript small, reads '(r)', possibly '(1)'); a black mouse cursor overlaps the third box
Key vectors: four horizontal stacks of 3 small green squares, each labeled K₁, K₂, K₃, K₄ in green text; red arrows carry them into the Dot Product box
visual_elements.position: between green ellipse and Dot Product box

visual_elements.description: Dot Product box: gray rectangle titled 'Dot Product' (black, top-left) with red 'K.q' at its top-right corner; inside, four blue circular nodes vertically staggered, interconnected by thin red directed arrows (pairwise-similarity graph); red arrows enter from the K stacks (left) and exit rightward toward Softmax
Query stage: red label 'q₂' beside a tiny 2-cell vector (yellow, purple) with arrow up into the Dot Product box; below it a white rectangle with red border containing 'W_q^(r)' in red

Sentence container (bottom-left): rounded rectangle with green dashed border holding 4 embedding rows of 3 cells each with red labels X₁–X₄; the X₂ row (purple cells) is wrapped in a red dashed outline; a red mouse-cursor arrow points up at X₂ from below; a faint dashed green curve links this container up to the input ellipse

Softmax block: tall vertical lavender rounded rectangle with the words 'Soft max' rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) in dark navy; receives red arrows from the Dot Product dots on its left edge and sends red arrows fanning out to the four ⊗ nodes on its right

Weighted-sum stage: white pill 'Weighted SUM' (blue text) above a light-blue rectangle containing a large blue 'Σ'; four red arrows rise from the ⊗ nodes into the bottom of the Σ box; a thick green block arrow points upward from Σ into the output box
Output box: small rectangle with green dashed border containing a row of 3 cells (green/gray) and green label 'V' — the final attention output vector

Multiply nodes: four circles stacked vertically under Σ, each white-filled with red border and a red '×' inside (⊗); each receives a red arrow from Softmax (left) and a red arrow carrying V_i from the right, and sends a red arrow up into Σ

Value stage: four green rectangles stacked vertically, each labeled 'W_v^(r)' in white; to their left, small 2-cell vectors (yellow/purple) with red labels V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ from top to bottom; red arrows run left from the vectors into the ⊗ nodes; short arrows connect the far-right embedding container to the W_v boxes

Right embedding container: rounded rectangle with green dashed border holding 4 embedding rows (3 multicolored cells each: yellow/salmon/purple) with red labels X₁–X₄; a faint dashed green curve links it down to the bottom-right dimension note

Dimension annotation box: white rectangle showing a small cell stack labeled '1*d' (red) → arrow → white square with black 'W' and red 'd*d' beneath it → '=' → cell stack labeled '1*d' (red); blue caption underneath: 'd: Embedding Length'

Arrow network: thin red arrows define all data flow (embeddings→W_k→K→Dot Product dots→Softmax→⊗→Σ; W_v→V_i→⊗; W_q→q₂→Dot Product); one thick green block arrow Σ→V output; faint dashed green connector curves bottom-left container→input ellipse and right container→dimension note
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with darker outline containing '13' in dark navy bold

imagery: No photographs or illustrations; the entire slide is built from vector shapes (ellipses, rectangles, dashed containers, arrows, small colored 'embedding cell' squares).

Two screen-recording mouse cursors are visible and are NOT slide content: a black arrow pointer over the third W_k^(r) box in the left green ellipse, and a red arrow pointer at bottom center-left pointing at the highlighted X₂ row.
A solid black strip runs across the very bottom edge of the frame — a video-player/letterbox artifact, not part of the slide.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout (Calibri/Arial-like). Title: bold, largest (~28–32 pt), two centered lines; the parenthetical '(Linear Transformation of Inputs)' is the same size in blue. Subtitle: bold, ~20 pt, black with red subscripted symbols. Diagram labels are small (~10–14 pt); math symbols use subscripts (X₁, K₁, q₂, V₁) and a superscript '(r)' on the W matrices. 'Soft max' is rotated 90° inside its block; 'Weighted SUM' uses all-caps 'SUM'. 'Similarity', 'Probabilities' and 'Weighted SUM' sit in small white rounded pills with blue text. W_k/W_v labels are white-on-green; W_q is red-on-white with red border.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — every pipeline stage, label, container and annotation is visible simultaneously; no mid-build bullet/shape reveal. The two visible mouse cursors indicate the recording captured live narration, but nothing is partially revealed.
recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: 16:9 slide, white #FFFFFF background, Calibri sans-serif everywhere.
2. Main panel: rectangle spanning x 3–97%, y 13–97%; fill #FCE4D2; thin red #C00000 border (~1 pt).
3. Title block: centered text box at x 15–85%, y 0–13% with two bold lines — line 1 'Self Attention Mechanism (Linear Transformation of Inputs)' (~28–32 pt): 'Self Attention Mechanism ' in black #000000 and '(Linear Transformation of Inputs)' in blue #0070C4; line 2 '(Self Attention of word X₂ w.r.t All words in Sentence ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ )' (~20 pt): black #000000 with the X symbols in red #C00000, using true subscripts.
4. Slide-number badge: circle at x 88–95%, y 3–12% (~0.5 in diameter); fill #FFD966, darker outline; bold '13' in dark navy #1F3864.
5. Input embedding ellipse: ellipse at x 5–20%, y 30–78%; fill #8496B0 at ~50% transparency, no border; inside, 4 horizontal rows of 3–4 small squares in #FFE699 / #FF7C80 / #C9A7E0, each row ending with a red #C00000 label X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄; a short red arrow exits each row rightward into the W_k boxes.
6. W_k ellipse: bright-green #00B050 vertical ellipse at x 17–28%, y 30–75%, overlapping the input ellipse; inside, 4 stacked green rectangles each labeled 'W_k^(r)' in bold white text (superscript '(r)').
7. K vectors: at x 21–30%, y 36–68%, draw 4 horizontal stacks of 3 light-green #A9D18E squares labeled K₁, K₂, K₃, K₄ in green #00B050; a red arrow runs from each stack into the Dot Product box.
8. Dot Product box: gray #D0CEC9 rectangle at x 27–37%, y 31–70%; 'Dot Product' in black at top-left and 'K.q' in red at top-right; inside, 4 blue #0070C4 circular nodes staggered vertically and joined pairwise by thin red directed arrows; red arrows enter from the K stacks (left) and exit toward Softmax (right).
9. Similarity pill: white rounded pill with blue #0070C4 text 'Similarity' at x 28–38%, y 26–31%, directly above the Dot Product box.
10. Query stage: at x 29–35%, y 71–84% (below the Dot Product box), red 'q₂' beside a 2-cell vector (one #FFE699 cell, one #C9A7E0 cell) with a red arrow up into the Dot Product box; below it, a white rectangle with red #C00000 border containing 'W_q^(r)' in red.
11. Sentence container: rounded rectangle at x 19–51%, y 83–93%, no fill, dashed green #00B050 border; inside, 4 rows of 3 cells in yellow #FFE699 / purple #C9A7E0 (the X₂ row all purple) with red labels X₁–X₄; wrap the X₂ row in a red dashed outline; add a faint dashed green curve from this container up to the input ellipse.
12. Softmax block: tall vertical rounded rectangle at x 47–52%, y 33–70%; fill lavender #E1C6F2; 'Soft max' rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) in dark navy #1F3864; red arrows enter its left edge from the Dot Product dots and fan out from its right edge to the 4 multiply nodes.
13. Probabilities pill: white rounded pill with blue #0070C4 text 'Probabilities' at x 45–55%, y 27–32%, above the Softmax block.
14. Σ / Weighted SUM: at x 54–72%, y 27–38%, place a white pill with blue #0070C4 text 'Weighted SUM' (all-caps 'SUM') and, directly below it, a light-blue #CFE2F3 rectangle containing a large blue #0070C4 'Σ'.
15. Output V box: small rectangle with dashed green #00B050 border at x 55–64%, y 20–26%; inside, a row of 3 cells (green #A9D18E / gray #D9D9D9) with green label 'V'; draw a thick green #00B050 block arrow pointing up from the Σ rectangle into this box.
16. Multiply nodes: 4 circles stacked vertically at x 55–61%, y 40–68%; white fill, red #C00000 border, red '×' inside each; a red arrow comes from Softmax into each node from the left, a red arrow brings the matching V vector in from the right, and a red arrow rises from each node into the bottom of the Σ rectangle.
17. Value stage: at x 63–77%, y 38–70%, stack 4 green #00B050 rectangles labeled 'W_v^(r)' in white; to their left, 4 small 2-cell vectors (yellow #FFE699 / purple #C9A7E0) labeled V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ from top to bottom in red #C00000, each with a red arrow running left into the corresponding ⊗ node.
18. Right embedding container: rounded rectangle with dashed green #00B050 border at x 78–87%, y 37–70%; inside, 4 rows of 3 multicolored cells (#FFE699, #FF7C80, #C9A7E0) with red labels X₁–X₄; short arrows connect the rows to the W_v boxes; a faint dashed green curve runs down to the dimension note.
19. Dimension note: white box at x 75–92%, y 82–95% containing a small cell stack labeled '1*d' in red → arrow → white square with black 'W' and red 'd*d' beneath it → '=' → cell stack labeled '1*d' in red; blue #0070C4 caption 'd: Embedding Length' underneath.
20. All remaining data-flow arrows are thin red #C00000 lines (embeddings→W_k→K→Dot Product; W_q→q₂→Dot Product). Do NOT draw the two mouse cursors (black pointer on the third W_k box, red pointer at the X₂ row) or the black strip along the bottom edge — all three are video-recording artifacts, not slide content.

fixes_applied: SCHEMA: verbatim_text.bullets is empty but legitimately absent — this is a diagram-only slide; all on-slide text is captured in the 29 label strings and 7 equation strings, so no bullets were fabricated.
CONSISTENCY: normalized the Dot Product box's blue from #0070C0 to #0070C4 so a single blue accent (#0070C4) is used for the dots, Σ, pill labels and title parenthetical, matching colors.accents.
CONSISTENCY: extended layout.hierarchy's blue-color summary to include the four Dot Product dots, which colors.accents already listed as blue.

RECREATABILITY: rewrote recreation_brief from 17 loosely-positioned steps into a 20-step ordered checklist; every step now places one element with its exact text, percent position copied from layout.regions, hex fill/border colors and shape type.

PRECISION: replaced the old brief's vague sentence-container cell note ('X₃/X₄ mixed') with the palette derivable from visual_elements — rows of 3 cells in #FFE699/#C9A7E0 with the X₂ row all purple inside a red dashed outline.
CONSISTENCY: kept the subtitle verbatim (including its unbalanced parenthesis) instead of silently correcting it, and flagged it in uncertain_items.

CONSISTENCY: added an explicit exclusion of the two mouse cursors and the bottom black strip to the checklist, since imagery declares them video artifacts even though layout.arrangement and the sentence-container region mention the cursor arrow.
uncertain_items: Superscript on the W boxes: transcribed as '(r)' on W_k^(r)/W_q^(r)/W_v^(r), but the extractor noted it may read '(1)'; '(r)' is used throughout.
Input-ellipse rows are described as '3–4 small colored squares' per row; the exact per-row cell count is not verifiable from the JSON (all other containers show 3 cells per row).
Subtitle parenthesis is unbalanced in the source transcription — '(Self Attention of word X₂ w.r.t All words in Sentence ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ )' has two '(' and one ')'; kept verbatim.
Translucency of the input ellipse (#8496B0) is not quantified in the source; the ~50% transparency in step 5 is a build approximation.
The two mouse cursors and the bottom black strip appear in the captured frame but are declared artifacts in imagery; they are described in layout/visual_elements yet excluded from recreation.
